slides.prompt:
Use case: text-localization / identity-preserve.
ADAPT the supplied existing portrait Instagram slide into a finished SQUARE 1:1 Instagram slide. Output must be square with equal width and height, ideally 1080 x1080 pixels. Completely reflow/reposition the foreground typography to fit a square layout: preserve all wording, accents, model versions and design. Do NOT just crop the portrait slide, cut off words, squeeze vertically, stretch people or add letterboxing. The real photograph must cover the entire square edge-to-edge behind text. Crop/reframe the existing photo naturally as needed for the square, with no new scenes or photo sources. Do not reconstruct people, retouch faces, change poses, clothes, hands or photo objects. On the two classroom slides preserve the strong EXISTING facial privacy blur; NO face details should be visible. Maintain original grain/blur and authentic photographic look.
Consistent design: monospaced developer type, JetBrains Mono-style, bold headline, warm white #F8FAFC with electric cyan #00E5FF highlights and straight cyan underlines. Scale type appropriately for square and phone reading, 6% safe margins, balanced hierarchy. Only gentle translucent navy gradients behind copy so the photo remains visible. No opaque panels, graphics, code windows, robots, extra photos, footer or bottom page counters. Keep the cover account top-left, no brand text on inner slides. Remove all old overlay typography then reapply exact copy in the new square composition. Do not overlay faces with text.
